{{Quote|I've heard rumors that the Rebellion is growing, becoming more powerful. If they could take out a weapon as great as the Death Star, there's no telling just how strong they really are. I think the Emperor is hiding that from us. I think he's hiding many things.|The stormtrooper|<ref name="Ruins" />}}
An '''individual''' served as a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], he and [[Unidentified stormtrooper 2 (Emperor's Retreat)|another stormtrooper]] were stationed at the [[Emperor's Retreat/Legends|personal retreat]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. At one point that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the stormtrooper was expressing to his colleague his doubts that the Empire would be repairing or replacing the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] that the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] had [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destroyed]]. The [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] also relayed rumors that the Alliance was growing more powerful as well as his belief that Palpatine was hiding important information from his subjects.

At that point, [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Loam Redge]], who had overheard the conversation, made his presence known and proceeded to berate the [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]]. After the Emperor's enforcer [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] also entered the room, Redge decreed that the two stormtroopers&mdash;whom he had enjoyed tormenting and who he reasoned had too much free [[Time/Legends|time]]&mdash;report for new orders that would result in them being stationed at a more challenging post.

==Biography==
===Rumors on duty===
{{Quote|I'm telling you that if they haven't repaired or replaced the Death Star by now, they won't. And that should tell you something.|The stormtrooper, to his colleague|<ref name="Ruins" />}}
[[File:Emperors_Retreat_CotF.png|thumb|right|300px|The stormtrooper was stationed at the personal retreat of Galactic Emperor Palpatine.]]
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual served as a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="Ruins" /> by [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="1 ABY">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Ruins of Dantooine]]'' to [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].</ref> during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], he was stationed at the [[Emperor's Retreat/Legends|personal retreat]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] on the latter's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. He and [[Unidentified stormtrooper 2 (Emperor's Retreat)|another stormtrooper]] were posted near a small [[computer terminal]] in a large antechamber leading to the Emperor's inner sanctum.<ref name="Ruins" />

At one point, while on duty, the stormtrooper was engaged in a clipped conversation with his colleague while casually leaning against the wall. The [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] claimed that, if by that [[Time/Legends|time]] the Empire had not yet either repaired the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] that the Alliance had [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destroyed]] a [[0 BBY/Legends|year earlier]], or begun the construction of a replacement for it<ref name="Ruins" />&mdash;with the manufacture of a [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] having in reality commenced even before the loss of the first [[Space station/Legends|station]]<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>&mdash;it would not be doing so at all. In response to the other trooper not being convinced by the claim and questioning its implications, the stormtrooper then noted, in a low voice, that he had heard rumors about the Alliance's recent increase in power, as evidenced by its ability to destroy the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]. Finally, he also expressed his suspicions that Palpatine was withholding important information from his subjects.<ref name="Ruins" />

===Overheard and reassigned===
{{Quote|Since you both have so much free time on your hands to reflect, I will see about relocating you to a post that you will undoubtedly find more&hellip; challenging. Perhaps something in the Hoth system. I don't believe we have sent many satellites out there yet. Report to your garrison commander for new orders. Your tour of duty here is now over.|Loam Redge, to the stormtrooper and his colleague|<ref name="Ruins" />}}
[[File:LoamRedge.png|thumb|left|300px|Inquisitor Loam Redge overheard the stormtroopers' conversation and subsequently had them reassigned to a more challenging post.]]
The stormtrooper's colleague warned him that he was risking [[Death/Legends|execution]] by such talk, and at that moment, [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Loam Redge]], who had been eavesdropping on the conversation, made his presence known to the two troopers. Caught off-guard, they both suddenly turned toward Redge, and the trooper who had made the claims stammered out an excuse that he had not been aware of the Inquisitor's presence. After Redge, who was enjoying the man's discomfort, remained silent, the stormtrooper apologized for his comments, which the Inquisitor interrupted by berating him about his lack of loyalty, reminding the trooper that he knew all that he needed to know. Pleased by the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] being too frightened to make any further comments, Redge then stated that the stormtrooper had nevertheless made a valid point: that the Empire still had to invest significant effort in order to prevail in the war against the Alliance.<ref name="Ruins" />

When the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]],<ref name="Ruins" /> Palpatine's enforcer,<ref name="CSWE Vader">{{CSWECite|III|288-289|Vader, Darth}}</ref> then entered the antechamber and demanded that Redge join him for a walk and a conversation, the two stormtroopers assumed an even straighter posture than they had at the Inquisitor's presence. Before he did so, however, Redge, reasoning that the troopers had too much free time on their hands, declared that their tour of duty at the retreat was over and that they were to report to their [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] for new orders. The Inquisitor intended for them to be transferred to a more challenging post, musing about<ref name="Ruins" /> the barren [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> as one such potential destination.<ref name="Ruins" />

==Equipment==
The stormtrooper donned a set of [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]], including a [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] with a [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitter]].<ref name="Ruins" />

==Behind the scenes==
The stormtrooper appeared in [[Voronica Whitney-Robinson]] and [[W. Haden Blackman|Haden Blackman's]] [[2003]] novel ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Ruins of Dantooine]]''.<ref name="Ruins" />
